## IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ

A pull request must close an issue that a maintainer has accepted (it has the `accepted` label).
Pull requests without one may be closed without review. Typo and documentation fixes are the exception.
Discuss new features on the community forum first: https://community.passbolt.com/c/backlog

Please write this description yourself. A tool does not know why you want to make this change.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/passbolt/go-passbolt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
